{{Quote|If Kreuge had only swept farther with the right wing at Salvara instead of turning when he did, the whole history of the Tenuutta Skirmishes would be different!|A [[Historian/Legends|historian]]|<ref name="GM Screen" />}}
The '''Battle of Salvara''' was a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] engagement that took place at the [[Salvara system/Legends|Salvara system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was part of the [[Tenuutta Skirmishes]].

==Prelude==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Guide" /> a series of conflicts known as the [[Tenuutta Skirmishes]] took place. The Battle of Salvara was part of the Tenuutta Skirmishes.<ref name="GM Screen" />

==The battle==
[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kreuge]] commanded the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces charged with participating at the Battle of Salvara. Unknown to [[Gender/Legends|him]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] agents at [[Handooine/Legends|Handooine]] had infected the [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Gibbon]]'' with a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] virus that had self-replicated and subsequently spread to the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. The virus caused all the ships in the fleet to lower their [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] once they got within a certain range during the battle,<ref name="Guide" /> which occurred when Kreuge turned his formation rather than continuing to sweep right.<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]&mdash;Armchair Historian template</ref> A potential Republic victory was turned into a rout.<ref name="Guide" />

==Aftermath==
Following the battle, it was speculated that if Admiral Kreuge had not commanded his forces to turn when they did and instead ordered the right wing of his forces to sweep further, the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] would have been considerably different.<ref name="TRG1" /> Admiral Kreuge made up for his defeat at Salvara by taking [[Kerkoidia/Legends|Kerkoidia]] soon after the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]].<ref name="Guide" />
